Perfect! All 59 tests pass. I've added:

**`src/numbering.js`** with **`nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)`**:
- Returns invoice numbers in format `INV-<year>-<counter>`
- Counter is 4 digits, zero-padded, starting at 0001 per year
- Resets to 0001 for each new year
- Handles unsorted numbers, gaps, and malformed entries robustly

**`issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)`** in `src/invoices.js`:
- Returns `ok(newInvoice)` with:
  - `number` assigned using `nextInvoiceNumber`
  - `status` changed from `'draft'` to `'issued'`
  - All other invoice data preserved
- Returns `NOT_DRAFT` if the invoice isn't a draft
- Never mutates the original invoice

Tests cover numbering logic (year transitions, sorting, malformed data), issuing logic (status changes, number generation), and mutation safety. ✔
